signals_info.description: Ego speed minus the applicable speed limit; positive values indicate speeding.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some future time, the condition speeding_margin > 5 shall newly become true.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在未来某个时刻，speeding_margin > 5 这一条件应刚开始成立。
nl_Paraphrase_en: At some future time, the vehicle's excess over the applicable speed limit shall rise above 5 km/h.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在未来某个时刻，车辆超过适用限速的幅度应增至 5 千米每小时以上。
